Name: ReverseFk
Description: Create a Bidirectional FK Chain - Forward and Reverse control simultaneously

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Create a Bidirectional FK Chain with Forward and Reverse controls active simultaneously.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- Mirror: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size (default 1).
- CtrlColor: choose one option (lightBlue, blue, white, purple, etc).
- CtrlType: choose one option (square, sphere, cube, octagon, etc).
- TwistAxis: rotation axis for FK controls.

Features:
- Forward FK: Control from root down the chain (full size).
- Reverse FK: Control from tip back up (85% size for distinction).
- FK_Direction slider (0-1): Blend between forward and reverse control influence.
- 0.5 default = equal influence from both systems.
